description:
Hi! We are Team Lux Aeterna, and this is our CLPS Lunar Mission Browser.

The CLPS program is sending commercial landers to the Moon,

where sunlight, Earth line-of-sight and terrain decide whether a mission

survives. We built this tool to make that choice visible: explore multiple

candidate landing sites in 3D, watch the sun and Earth move over time, and

compare sites side by side.

Lux Aeterna means "eternal light," which is what every south-pole lander

is chasing.
